summary: Accendra Health filed an 8-K to announce early results of exchange offers and consent solicitations for its existing senior notes. Holders tendered ~99.9% of 2029 Notes ($478.3M) and ~99.2% of 2030 Notes ($547.9M). Newly issued 9.000% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2032 and 9.750% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2033 were offered. Supplemental indentures adopted eliminating substantially all covenants. This is a liability management transaction refinancing debt, not an M&A or special-situation corporate event. The filing is a routine current report of a debt exchange; no premium, acquisition, or strategic restructuring is present.
